note: Fresh nationwide Page Profit Check nightly batch. Ten public small-business opportunities only; one isolated worker per opportunity; no outreach is sent.

items.name: CRFS, LLC
items.vertical: metal fabrication, welding, CNC plasma cutting, laser engraving, 3D printing, CAD design
items.summary: Metal-fabrication Wix site has real services, email, phone, and service-area cues, but the homepage still shows template booking leftovers like repeated Service Name / $19.99 blocks and misspelled service labels.
items.angle: keep the straightforward industrial/welding look while replacing template residue with clear fabrication paths, proof, and a quote-starting flow.

items.name: Stark Electric LLC
items.summary: Licensed and insured electrician site has phone/email and 24-hour/free-estimate language, but the first screen and service cards rely on generic Wix structure and weak estimate hierarchy.
items.angle: preserve the simple electrician template and tool imagery while lifting license proof, emergency availability, core service paths, and the estimate CTA.

items.name: Going Places Cleaning Service, LLC
items.vertical: cleaning service, floor care, window cleaning, post-construction cleaning, pressure washing
items.summary: Cleaning site lists several valuable services plus address/email/phone, but it opens with generic service-company copy, duplicate contact details, and a weak buyer path.
items.angle: keep the simple Wix cleaning-service style while organizing residential, floor care, post-construction, windows, and pressure-washing paths around a quote request.

items.name: Let Us Plan It, LLC
items.vertical: event planning, wedding packages, party packages, showers, personalized and rental items
items.summary: Event-planning Wix site has concrete packages and pricing, but the page jumps straight into booking cards without trust proof, event-fit guidance, or a clear consultation flow.
items.angle: preserve the lightweight event-package feel while adding occasion paths, planning proof, pricing context, and a consult-first next step.

items.name: Mike's X-Treme LLC
items.vertical: golf cart upgrades and repair, batteries, lift kits, audio, wraps, tires, wheels
items.summary: Golf-cart repair/upgrades site has a distinctive niche, address, hours, phone, and service list, but the homepage can make repair vs upgrade intent and free estimates much clearer.
items.angle: keep the casual golf-cart shop personality while grouping repairs, upgrades, and diagnostics into scan-friendly quote paths.

items.name: Dig It Landscaping LLC
items.vertical: landscaping, lawn care, irrigation repair, trimming, yard maintenance, installation
items.summary: Landscaping site has owner story, email, phone, and valuable services, but it still includes repeated Service Name / $19.99 template blocks and fake testimonial copy.
items.angle: preserve the personal owner-operated landscape feel while removing template leftovers and surfacing irrigation, lawn care, trimming, and maintenance quote paths.

items.name: Leon Home Innovations LLC
items.vertical: home improvement service, repair, renovation, virtual and in-person estimates
items.summary: Home-improvement site has email, phone, estimate options, and a service promise, but generic copy and a fake testimonial block weaken trust before visitors inquire.
items.angle: keep the straightforward home-improvement Wix style while clarifying project types, estimate options, proof, and what happens after reaching out.

items.name: HMS, LLC
items.vertical: handyman services, home improvement, repairs, renovations, odd jobs
items.summary: Handyman site has a personable neighborhood positioning, free-estimate language, email, and phone, but the service paths and first-screen CTA can be much sharper.
items.angle: preserve the neighborhood-handyman feel while turning odd jobs, repairs, and projects into clear task paths with a free-estimate next step.

items.name: D & E Spotless Cleaning Services LLC
items.vertical: residential and commercial cleaning, move-in/move-out, deep cleaning, basic cleaning
items.summary: Cleaning-service Wix site has real service cards, email, phone, and a quote link, but obvious menu/template leftovers and placeholder testimonial copy damage trust.
items.angle: keep the simple cleaning-company design while removing leftovers, clarifying cleaning packages, and making quote requests feel safer and more specific.

items.name: C&S Window Cleaning LLC

items.summary: Window-cleaning site has a clear local service, phone/email, guarantee, and service pages, but long generic sections and spelling/template issues dilute the quote path.
